{"id":1962444800,"question_id":4114,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"3 months, 3 weeks","timestamp":1774755977,"status":10,"status_display":"Accepted","runtime":"175 ms","url":"/submissions/detail/1962444800/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Incremental Even-Weighted Cycle Queries","memory":"332 MB","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    vector<int>parent;\n    vector<int>sum;\n    \n    int find(int i)\n    {\n        if(parent[i] == i) return i;\n        int root = parent[i];\n        parent[i] = find(parent[i]);\n        sum[i] = (sum[i] + sum[root]) % 2;\n        return parent[i];\n    }\n\n    bool Union(int u , int v , int w){\n        int pu = find(u);\n        int pv = find(v);\n\n        if(pu == pv){\n            return ((sum[u] + sum[v]) % 2) == (w % 2);\n        }\n        parent[pu] = pv;\n        sum[pu] = (sum[u] + sum[v] + w) % 2;\n        return true;\n    }\n    \n    int numberOfEdgesAdded(int n, vector<vector<int>>& edges) {\n        parent.resize(n , 0);\n        sum.resize(n , 0);\n        \n        for(int i = 0 ; i<n ; i++){\n            parent[i] = i;\n        }\n\n        int count = 0;\n        for(auto it : edges){\n            int u = it[0];\n            int v = it[1];\n            int w = it[2];\n            if(Union(u , v , w)) count++;\n        }\n        return count; \n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"incremental-even-weighted-cycle-queries","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":1889}
